limitations: Only saved theta from existing cells is reaggregated; no new donor/patient information.

Held patients were excluded from optimization, not from inherited upstream QC/gene universe/reference.
Topic match is conditional on a full-discovery reference including held expression, not orthogonal identity.
Training-only panel fits remain conditional on inherited QC/raw gene universe and supplied labels.
Threshold origin is bound to saved receipts/upstream verification, not independently refitted here.
Historical checkpoint reload claims are not a reload performed in this run.
Pooling fixes an estimand mismatch, not technical/compositional confounding or clinical validation.
